lines.text: David sang to the LORD when He delivered him from his enemies and from Saul, calling Him his rock and fortress.
The cords of Sheol entangled David, so in his distress he cried out to the LORD, who heard from His temple.
The earth shook because the LORD burned with anger, and He mounted a cherub and flew on the wings of the wind.
God trains David's hands for battle, and David says his arms can bend a bow of iron.
God delivered David from the strife of his people and kept him as head of nations, and foreigners obey him.
